title: A Particle From Space Can Flip Your Computer's Memory
description:
A particle born from cosmic radiation can change a stored 0 into a 1—without breaking the chip. Here’s how a single-event upset happens and how error-correcting memory fights back.

Sources:
ESA — Swarm vs. space radiation: https://www.esa.int/Enabling_Support/Space_Engineering_Technology/Swarm_vs._space_radiation_the_first_10_years
IBM Research — Terrestrial cosmic rays: https://research.ibm.com/publications/terrestrial-cosmic-rays
